title: Trace-Log Linker: Enrich OTLP and Log Pipelines with Trace IDs and Build Joinable Dashboards
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: When investigating latency spikes or errors, engineers frequently need to correlate traces with logs. Current pipelines produce traces (OTLP -> Tempo) and logs (Fluentd/Vector -> Loki/CloudLogging) independently and only a minority of logs contain trace identifiers (trace_id/span_id). This makes root-cause work slow and increases mean time to resolution for production incidents.

Goal: Implement a robust Trace-Log Linker so logs emitted across services reliably include a joinable trace_id, ensure sampled-out traces are annotated so logs can still be grouped, and build Grafana dashboards that let SREs pivot from a trace to surrounding logs and from log views to high-latency traces. The feature must be low-latency, have minimal ingestion cost impact, and preserve PII governance (redaction and consent-aware retention).
acceptance_criteria: >99% of application logs ingested via central log pipeline contain a trace_id field when a trace context exists in incoming request headers or SDKs

If a request was sampled out, logs should include synthetic_trace_marker to allow grouping with traces that later arrive; synthetic markers must be deterministic per-request and avoid leaking user identifiers
End-to-end pipeline tested: sample app emits traces and logs; querying dashboard allows clicking a trace to surface the 50 most recent logs with same trace_id within 30s window
Streaming transform latency added by linker < 5ms p95 to avoid impacting ingest SLOs
Storage overhead from trace tags on logs must be measured and documented; bill impact estimate for hosted customers provided
Design doc, PRs, e2e tests, and runbook exist and have been reviewed by Observability and Security teams
tasks: Design: finalize OTLP->Log transform spec with schema (trace_id, span_id optional, synthetic_trace_marker) - owner @Ava
Implement ingest-transform: add a TraceLinker processor in the OTLP relay that enriches logs with trace_id when present - owner @Diego
Implement synthetic marker generator for sampled-out contexts and ensure deterministic derivation from request-id (HMAC with rotation) - owner @Diego
Update Vector/Fluentd config to preserve trace headers and forward trace fields to Loki/CloudLogging - owner @Sofia
Add optional customer flag to disable linking for compliance-sensitive tenants - owner @Priya
Create Grafana dashboard panels: Trace to Logs pane (Tempo + Loki join) and Logs to Trace quick-links - owner @Maya
E2E tests: synthetic workload that creates 10k traces+logs and validates joinability and latency - owner @QA
Runbook: triage steps to use dashboard when investigating P95 latency regressions - owner @SRE
Add metrics: linker_added_latency_ms (histogram), linked_logs_count, synthetic_marker_rate - owner @Telemetry
comments: 2025-02-11 - Ava Chen: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed to implement linker in central OTLP relay for best coverage; sidecar approach left as follow-up for edge cases. Security to review synthetic marker derivation.

2025-02-15 - Diego Martinez: Initial prototype implemented in relay-transform branch. Uses incoming W3C traceparent header. Needs deterministic synthetic marker for sampled-out flows; current naive hash revealed potential for user-id leakage during review.

2025-02-18 - Priya Raman (Security): Feedback: synthetic marker must be HMAC(key rotated) over request-id or combination of non-PII fields; store no raw identifiers. Also require tenant opt-out flag for GDPR-bound customers.
2025-02-21 - Sofia Lee: Updated vector config to preserve traceparent->trace_id mapping; tested with staging Loki, small change required to JSON logging codec to add trace_id at root level.

2025-02-25 - Maya Torres: Grafana prototype uses Tempo trace links and Loki query interpolation; proof-of-concept panel allows clicking a span and running a Loki query for {trace_id="..."} automatically. UX feedback: show synthetic marker indicator prominently.

2025-02-27 - Diego Martinez: End-to-end e2e test passed on staging with 5k trace+log pairs. Measured additional median ingest latency 1.8ms, p95 4.6ms. Storage overhead ~2.7% across sample workload. Preparing PR for relay + vector updates.
2025-03-01 - Ava Chen: Security review completed (notes attached in Confluence). Minor request: add key rotation playbook and revoke path. Assigned to @Diego for inclusion before release.
Follow-ups: investigate adding span-level log linking (span_id) for sampled-in traces, and a lightweight sidecar option for clients that cannot forward trace headers through proxies.
